text:
Diego: quick thread — decision needed for starter UX: keep the popover modal for sample projects or move to an inline "shelf" at the top of the console? leaning shelf (less interruptive). :thinking:
Ava: +1 to shelf. Popover feels like a gate and breaks keyboard flow. Shelf can be persistent but subtle.
Sam: agree with Ava. From research: people skip modals, but a small shelf with 2-3 curated samples increased try-rate in tests.
Ravi: shelf will affect header layout. Implementation-wise it's ~1 day for markup + CSS and another day for animation polish. Popover is quicker but technical debt for a11y fixes.
Lina: accessibility nits if we go shelf: must ensure focusable controls, skip-link, and announce on first-render only. Contrast on cards needs to meet AA for text over image. Also keyboard collapse/expand behavior must not trap focus.
Diego: good callouts. Is there a hybrid? show shelf by default on first-run, then auto-collapse for returning users?
Ava: hybrid sounds nice. For first-run add an "Explore starter samples" CTA and aria-live message. For returning users show a collapsed rail with a chevron.
Sam: follow-up: we should link specific samples to the new quickstart checklist steps so people can complete a sample and mark step done. That drives activation.
Ravi: implementation note — linking to checklist state means we need route params or a tiny onboarding store. I'd prefer a route param: /project/:id?onboard_sample=vector-chat. Clean and stateless.
Ravi: small code sketch:
```
// example route link
<Link to={`/projects/${p.id}?onboard_sample=${sample.slug}`}>Open sample</Link>
```
Ava: copy suggestion for shelf header: "Try a starter project — 3 quick demos" vs "Sample projects". Which is clearer?
Sam: "Try a starter project" is more action-oriented. Add microcopy: "Complete one to see Redwood in your app"
Diego: +1. Also want analytics event names: shelf_shown, shelf_collapsed, shelf_sample_started. Sam can we add tracked funnel?
Sam: yes, will add events and a small pulse test for first-week retention.
Lina: a11y checklist for engineering: 1) keyboard order, 2) aria-live only on first-render, 3) high contrast label, 4) focus return when sample modal closes. I'll put that into the PR review checklist.
Ava: visual variants to deliver for engineering: A) full shelf with thumbnails, B) compact chip rail, C) collapsed summary line with chevron. We should A/B A vs B for new signups.
Diego: timeline? we want this in next sprint if feasible. Ravi think it's 2-3 days dev + QA?
Ravi: estimate 3 dev days + 1 qa day + a11y pass. If we cut animation polish maybe 2 dev days.
Diego: ok aim for MVP (compact chip rail + route param + analytics) in sprint. Leave fancy thumbnails for follow-up.
onboard-bot: Reminder: design handoff doc requested — please attach Figma link and component tokens by EOD Friday.
Ava: linking Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/starter-shelf — includes tokens and states.
Diego: final decision summary: implement compact shelf for first-run, collapses for returning users, route param for sample launch, analytics events, and follow-up A/B with full thumbnails. Lina to add a11y checklist to PR. Sam to add analytics/funnel. Ravi to create spike branch.
Lina: sounds good — will watch for PR and focus test. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll draft the funnel events and share the pulse test plan tomorrow.
Ravi: starting branch now — will ping when initial PR is up.
Diego: thanks team — moving this to the roadmap board and marking as "in sprint" for next cycle. :rocket:
